what: Real-browser check of the 100-run simulation (Plan step 5). SIMULATED data: no MicroVMs were started.
setup: Built-in browser pane, viewport emulated at 1440x900, control plane started with HARNESS_DEMO=1 (demo mode), commit 9b17399 plus the uncommitted demo-mode change.
method: A script in the page sampled the DOM every 100 ms and counted tiles by CSS class (.resuming/.ready/.running/.done/.error).

runs.note: The browser pane was hidden for the first ~19 s, so requestAnimationFrame was paused and rendering stalled and then caught up when the pane was shown. Timing from this run is NOT used; only the end state is.

network: Exactly one POST /simulate?n=100 (202) and one GET /simulate/<id>/stream per simulation; the stream request shows net::ERR_ABORTED only because the client closed it after simulation_done. No reconnect requests.
ui: Clicking a finished tile opened that run in the Rail and the Reasoning, Terminal and Diff panels; the Simulated banner stayed visible; no push button appeared.
screenshot: simulation-100-in-progress.jpg (taken during run A, 100 in progress)
not_checked: Chrome/Firefox/Safari (only the built-in browser), mobile layout, accessibility tooling.
